messages:
Riley Park: FYI MonarchPay wants a 7-10 day POC to validate a drop-in compat bridge from their current vendor to Redwood. Top asks: token-for-token billing parity, identical stop semantics, and security questionnaire answered. Can eng + security scope?

Samir Desai: I can lead the POC. Need their canonical prompts (40) and 12 failure cases. Clarify whether token parity must be exact or if a +/-1 tolerance is acceptable.

Clara Zhou: They stated "exact match" in the RFP. Practical approach: run their tokenizer in the adapter to emit vendor token_count. That adds CPU but gives fidelity. We'll include a deterministic mode for verification runs.

Vivian Hart: SecQ highlights: KMS options, no plaintext storage of tokens, SOC2 Type II, pen-test summary, and EU data residency preference. I'll draft answers; please upload architecture diagram and token flow.

Samir Desai: Minimal shim curl we can hand them:

curl -X POST https://shim.monarchpay.poc/api/v1/completions
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <MON_POC_KEY>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize invoice 99","length":64,"stop":["\n\n"],"temperature":0.0}'

Samir Desai: Shim behavior: maps length->max_new_tokens, runs vendor tokenizer to compute vendor_token_count, echoes X-Monarch-ReqId, and returns X-Token-Report header: vendor=123;redwood=123;delta=0.

Clara Zhou: Ops note: running vendor tokenizer may add ~20-50ms median latency. Recommend a short dedicated pool for the POC or accept a small adapter surcharge.

Vivian Hart: For KMS: hosted POC supports envelope encryption and we won't persist raw tokens. If they require HSM/BYOK, that's a Private deployment discussion. I'll include that distinction in secQ.

Riley Park: Commercial ask: they prefer fixed-fee POC + usage. Samir/Clara, please propose hosted-adapter surcharge vs dedicated pool pricing.

Samir Desai: Proposed acceptance criteria draft:
- median latency <= 140ms, p95 <= 300ms on staging
- token_delta_rate <= 0.5% on canonical set
- no persisted plaintext customer API tokens
- parity artifacts: CSV with prompt, vendor_text, redwood_text, vendor_tokens, redwood_tokens, delta, sim_score

Clara Zhou: We'll compute sim_score using embeddings + lexical metric and flag any score <0.8 for manual review. We'll also provide a small script to reproduce diffs locally.

ops-bot: Sandbox 'monarchpay-poc-01' provisioned (sbx-331). Vault: credentials uploaded, access granted to thread participants.

Riley Park: Action items: Samir to push shim + harness repo, Clara to draft ops runbook & pricing options, Vivian to start secQ answers and attach SOC2/pen-test snippets. Target sandbox ready in 48-72h and kickoff in 72h.

Samir Desai: Starting harness now. Will post repo link and sample X-Token-Report header format when ready.

Riley Park: Thanks team. We'll sync with MonarchPay tomorrow @ 9am PT. :thumbsup:
